claims.evidence: No manufacturer logo, casting marks, or legible plate/sticker visible in any photo; the witness could not read the sticker text on the block or cover.
No VIN tag, engine code, or model-specific casting number is legible in the photos; witness only confirms a generic 4-cylinder bare engine.
Photos show pulleys, belts, hoses, wiring, and the head/valve cover, but witness explicitly notes harness/ECU/transmission completeness is not shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be a Toyota or RAV4 unit (mislabeled or generic engine).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the legible engine block casting number, VIN/engine code tag, or a Toyota logo stamp.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/unverified-fitment used engine, not RAV4-specific

risks.risk: Running condition unknown; could be seized, misfiring, or have low compression.
risks.proof: Video/audio clip of the engine actually running and idling smoothly.
Odometer photo from the donor vehicle or service/maintenance records.

risks.risk: Possible internal wear, leaks, or damage not visible externally (e.g., head gasket, bearings).
risks.proof: Close-up of oil pan/valve cover for leak stains, plus a compression test readout or borescope clip.

risks.risk: Missing ancillary components (ECU, wiring harness, transmission, injectors, sensors) that buyer may assume are included.
risks.proof: Full photo set of all included parts laid out, with an itemized list matching the photos.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, excluding ECU/harness/transmission

risks.risk: Surface rust seen on a bracket could indicate storage in poor/corrosive conditions, suggesting hidden corrosion elsewhere.
risks.proof: Wide shot of the full engine including underside and all brackets in good lighting.

risks.risk: Reason for removal unknown (accident, swap, failure) which affects reliability.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the donor vehicle or a statement with supporting documentation (not just seller's words).
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming removal due to failure/accident (worst case)

proof_requests: Clear close-up of engine block casting number, engine code sticker, or VIN/engine tag
Video of the engine running with audible sound (cold start preferred)
Photo of odometer or any available service history
Full itemized photo of all included parts (ECU, harness, injectors, transmission if any)
Wide shots of engine underside and all sides for leak/rust/damage assessment
response.reason: The witness confirms a bare used engine exists, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-fitment, condition-unknown long block; the Toyota/RAV4 claim and completeness remain unproven and should not raise the price until verified.
